## Abstract

We describe a corpus of spoken Irish derived from audiobooks available on
leighleat.ie, an Irish-language audiobook platform. Because the audio is
under copyright, the corpus is distributed as stand-off annotations: time-
aligned text and phonetic transcriptions that reference the original audio
at its source URL. Users who obtain the audio — by streaming or downloading
from leighleat.ie — can reconstruct the corpus locally. We describe the
annotation pipeline, the stand-off format, and the linguistic properties of
the material collected.
